title: Set up on pay day before the pay is in: the opening saves it as not in yet (decision X3, F20; confirm_review_1 item 3)
story: Set up Fri 25 Jun 2027 at 08:00, pay day. The bank holds 40,000; the pay of 250,000 has not come in yet, and setup asks about it first (a pay due that day): the person says not yet, so the opening saves it in `not_yet`. Pay is monthly on the 25th (moved earlier) and starts the period; rent of 80,000 on the 27th (moved later: Mon 28 Jun); Free to spend is 60,000 a month. At the check-in on Sat 26 Jun at 10:00 the person ticks the pay (it came in on 25 Jun) and types the bank: 290,000. Before X3 the model took the setup day's pay as already inside the opening: day one said 40,000 short, the pay never reached the check-in list and never started a period. Every amount is made up.

asks.question: headline
asks.why: 40,000 (Bank today; the pay of Fri 25 Jun is not in yet and is still expected today, so nothing is short) = 40,000
asks.note: Before X3: 0, with 40,000 short (the rent taken off with no pay to come before it).

asks.question: check_in_list
asks.why: 250,000 (the pay of Fri 25 Jun: setup was told it was not in yet, so the first check-in asks about it) = 250,000

asks.question: bank_today
asks.why: 40,000 (opening, Fri 25 Jun 08:00) + 250,000 (the pay of 25 Jun, ticked Sat 26 Jun; not inside the opening) = 290,000

asks.question: headline
asks.why: 60,000 (Free to spend: the pay of Fri 25 Jun started the period) = 60,000

asks.question: warnings
asks.why: The check-in figure is what the app had (the opening and the ticked pay), so no gain is asked about.
